content: दण्डिन् {%a.%} [दण्ड-अस्त्यर्थे इनि] Bearing or having a staff; न शक्या धर्मतो हन्तुं कालेनापीह दण्डिना <ls>Mb. 9. 61. 66</ls>. --{%m.%} .²1 A Brāhmaṇa of the fourth order, a {%Samnyāsin%}, .²2 A door-keeper, porter. .²3 An oarsman. .²4 A Jaina ascetic. .²5 An epithet of Yama. .²6 A king. .²7 A religious mendicant (Bhikṣu). .²8 An epithet of Śiva. .²9 <ab>N.</ab> of a poet, author of the Kāvyādarśa and Daśakumāracharita; जाते जगति वाल्मीके कविरित्यभिधाऽभवत् . कवी इति ततो व्यासे कवयस्त्वयि दण्डिनि .. <ls>Udb.</ls>
